# Pre-Attachment Environment Discovery Subsystem

This document outlines the operational boundaries, data models, and asynchronous discovery tracks used to audit an active emulator directory installation prior to process hook attachments.

---

## 🧭 Principles & Lifecycle States

*   **Isolation Guarantee:** Environment scanning is purely a disk-bound and local binary query operation. It is decoupled from raw memory introspection logic and requires zero process handle permissions.
*   **Immutable Resolution:** Once a data model is successfully generated by the parser, its fields remain static and available to downstream driver components via Dependency Injection.

---

## 📊 Discovery Sequence Timeline

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Operator as UI UI Operator
    participant VM as MainViewModel
    participant Discovery as EmulatorEnvironmentDiscovery
    participant Model as EmulatorEnvironmentModel
    participant Disk as Local Filesystem (.nemu)
    participant CLI as mumu-cli.exe Binary

    Operator->>VM: Clicks "Scan Directory" Ribbon Button
    activate VM
    VM->>Discovery: Invokes Async Scan(MumuInstallDirectory)
    deactivate VM
    activate Discovery
    
    Discovery->>Disk: Audits file boundaries & Resolves nemu-config.json path
    Discovery->>CLI: Spawns hidden mumu-cli.exe process with query flags
    CLI-->>Discovery: Pipes back environment metrics text
    
    Discovery->>Model: Instantiates populated structural model instance
    activate Model
    Model-->>Discovery: Returns active reference instance
    deactivate Model
    
    Discovery-->>VM: Returns completed discovery result payload
    deactivate Discovery
    activate VM
    VM->>VM: Populates UI logging canvases & maps Singleton data state
    deactivate VM
```



## 📊 Pre-Attachment Scanning Data Pipeline

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Operator as Operator Panel (UI)
    participant VM as MainViewModel
    participant ED as EmulatorEnvironmentDiscovery
    participant JO as System.Text.Json DOM
    participant OS as Local Storage IO

    Operator->>VM: Fires "Scan Directory" Click Event
    activate VM
    VM->>ED: Awaits ScanDirectoryAsync(MumuInstallDirectory)
    deactivate VM
    activate ED
    ED->>OS: Probes Absolute Path Mappings via System.IO
    OS-->>ED: Returns nemu-config.json File Handle Context
    
    ED->>JO: Executes JsonDocument.Parse()
    activate JO
    JO->>JO: Searches for ['memory']['lower_arena_bytes'] properties
    JO-->>ED: Populates dynamic Lower & Upper byte buffers
    deactivate JO
    
    ED-->>VM: Returns fully populated EmulatorEnvironmentModel instance
    deactivate ED
    activate VM
    VM->>VM: Maps live memory state bindings thread-safely
    deactivate VM
```
